# Evidence from the data:
# 17: tēhuetzītia = tē- (indefinite object) + huetzi (fall) + -tia (causative), "makes somebody fall"
# 1sg subject prefix is ni- (niki, nitlahtoa, nimitztlazohtla); 2sg is ti-; 3sg has no prefix.

# Causative lengthens the final vowel -i -> -ī; undo to get the base verb
if stem.endswith("ī"):
    stem = stem[:-1] + "i"    # "huetzi"

        "causative_form": causative,

        "intransitive_no_object_prefix": True
    }
}, ensure_ascii=False))
